title: Otter waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9ff3e0'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#5fd4c4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3fb8ad'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='80' rx='15' ry='8' fill='#8a5a3b' transform='rotate(-15 76 80)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#a56b45'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#e9c9a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='38' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#b07347'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#e9c9a8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='5' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='30' r='5' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='36' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2b2b3d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#2b2b3d'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='34.5' r='1.6' fill='#d9fbf4'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='34.5' r='1.6' fill='#d9fbf4'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#3a2a2f'/>
  <ellipse cx='40.8' cy='43.2' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#7d6570'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M42 47.5 q-4 4 -8 1' stroke='#6b4a35' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 47.5 q4 4 8 1' stroke='#6b4a35' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M30 45 l-9 -3' stroke='#f0dcc4' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 48 l-9 2' stroke='#f0dcc4' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 45 l9 -3' stroke='#f0dcc4' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 48 l9 2' stroke='#f0dcc4' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm resting -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='82' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#a56b45' transform='rotate(15 33 82)'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <path d='M68 60 q10 -14 6 -26' stroke='#b07347' stroke-width='11' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving paw with lighter pads -->
  <circle cx='74' cy='32' r='8' fill='#b07347'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='26' r='3' fill='#e9c9a8'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='24' r='3' fill='#e9c9a8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='28' r='3' fill='#e9c9a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='37' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#e9c9a8'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
</svg>
